name: Trained-bee explosive sniffer
effect: pairing a signal with a reward trains a reflex
how: Honeybees are trained in minutes by giving sugar water each time they smell a trace of explosive, until the smell alone makes them stick out their tongues. A handheld box pumps air past a few harnessed bees while a camera and computer watch for the reflex. They beat many electronic noses for sensitivity.
why: A Pavlovian reflex turned into a living chemical sensor.
